violations.text: Bottled berry balsamic dressing was not approved by RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Placed under embargo during this inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Raw animal foods (shelled eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (smoothies, prepared meals) in the reach-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Bottled dressing was observed with incomplete labels. Packaged foods must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
